name: pod_logs
description: App plugin: browse the log files of an OpenShift namespace's pods like a file explorer, view them read-only with search highlighting, narrow them to a time range, and save them. Opens text files, .zip, .tar.gz and .gz. Read-only.
author: Aravinthan Selvaraj

system_requirements.name: oc
system_requirements.note: OpenShift command line client (not needed with dry_run).

arguments.name: environment
arguments.description: OpenShift environment whose oc.generic login session is used (log in with oc.generic first). Required unless dry_run is set.

arguments.name: namespace
arguments.description: OpenShift project to browse; the session's current project when empty. It can be changed on the live page.

arguments.name: default_paths
arguments.description: Log folders (or files) shown for every pod, besides each container's console log.

arguments.name: log_paths
arguments.description: Log folders or files per deployment: deployment name (or a pattern such as api-*) to a list of absolute paths, shown after the default paths.

arguments.name: timezone
arguments.description: Time zone of the From/To times typed on the page and of log timestamps that carry no zone.

arguments.name: max_read_mb
arguments.description: Most MB read from one file: larger logs are read from their end; larger archives are refused.

arguments.name: max_lines
arguments.description: Most lines shown in the viewer (the newest), and read from a console log.

arguments.name: max_bundle_mb
arguments.description: Most MB in one download of the listed logs; files past it are left out and named in its README.txt.

arguments.name: dry_run
arguments.description: Use built-in sample pods, folders and archives instead of OpenShift, to try the page locally; no oc login needed.

outputs.name: pods
outputs.description: One entry per pod listed: pod, deployment, status and its log paths.

outputs.name: opened
outputs.description: Files opened in the viewer, as pod/container: path.

outputs.name: saved
outputs.description: Files saved for download (single files and bundles of the listed logs), relative to the workspace.

app.title: Pod logs
app.description: Pick a pod to see its console log, the default log paths and the paths configured for its deployment. Click a folder or archive to look inside, and a file to read it. Search highlights matches; the time range narrows what is shown.

inputs.name: namespace
inputs.label: Namespace
inputs.placeholder: Blank: the argument, else the session's project

inputs.name: from
inputs.label: From
inputs.description: Start of the Between range, in the plugin's timezone argument (UTC by default).

inputs.name: to
inputs.label: To
inputs.description: End of the Between range, in the plugin's timezone argument (UTC by default).

inputs.name: save
inputs.label: Save
inputs.description: Save the open file, narrowed to the time range, and download it

inputs.name: download_filtered
inputs.label: Download listed (time range)
inputs.description: One .zip of every listed log, narrowed to the time range: console logs of the listed pods and the files in opened folders

inputs.name: download_all
inputs.label: Download listed (everything)
inputs.description: One .zip of every listed log as it is: console logs of the listed pods and the files in opened folders
